label: Docs — Create and schedule batch calls, agent bound via From Number
note: Retell picks the agent for a batch call indirectly, by choosing the From Number that agent is already bound to in Settings, so the run inherits the agent without a second agent-picker on the form, and pays for it with an extra hop (bind agent to number first, then pick the number) before a batch can be created.
